title: Twin Star Exorcists
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Rokuro Enmado, who gave up on becoming an exorcist after a tragedy, meets Benio Adashino, an exorcist whose family was killed by Kegare demons (to verify). The two are named the Twin Star Exorcists, foretold to marry and bear a child who will end the Kegare, and must fight together in the demon realm of Magano (to verify).
life_message: It holds up partnership, perseverance through grief and accepting a shared duty to protect others.

content.note: Ongoing demon battles and a war with Kegare; deaths of allies; likely higher (to verify; AniList War tag).
Grisly demons and Rokuro's past tragedy (to verify).
Teens destined to have a child; fan service and nudity (to verify; AniList Nudity 79%, MangaDex suggestive).
Survivor guilt from the incident that ended Rokuro's training (to verify).
Anime adaptation and Jump Square promotion (to verify).
